messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "stop biotin and biotin-containing supplements at least 2 days before thyroid blood test"
set: ["stop biotin and biotin-containing supplements at least 2 days before thyroid blood test", "stop using for at least 48 hours before test", "supplements containing biotin", "stop using at least 2 months before planning to get pregnant", "at least five days", "take at least 2 hours before antacid containing aluminum and magnesium hydroxide", "falsely high or low thyroid blood test results", "biotin", "wait at least 14 days after stopping before starting MAOI", "take other medications at least 2 hours before or after", "given for at least five days before the dose is increased", "exercising at least 30 minutes most days", "take at least 8 hours before aspirin", "take at least 4 hours before resin", "time between two doses must be at least 2 days (>48 hours)", "wait at least 2 weeks after stopping an MAOI before starting fluoxetine"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
